import itertools
from syntax import parse_policy
from ebpf.create_dfa import create
names=[chr(65+i) for i in range(16)];reg=[{'name':n,'label':i+1} for i,n in enumerate(names)]
paths=[','.join(names[i] for i in tup) for tup in itertools.islice(itertools.product(range(16),repeat=5),5000)]
text=''.join('match('+p+') allow;' for p in paths)
p=parse_policy(text)
print(len(p.rules),p.atoms,len(p.match_paths))
im=create(text,reg,p)
print(len(im['rows']),sum(im['accept']))
